pricing_policy: Track Amazon (r.jina.ai/dp/<ASIN>) REGULAR/typical street price. Ignore timeboxed event promos (Prime Deal price, lightning deals) unless the regular price itself has moved >10% vs stored. Update only on >10% move. Cross-check with Firecrawl /clp/<ASIN> when a move looks large.
